description: RightChoice Analysis Bot connects ChatGPT to your RightChoice.ai account so you can ask questions about your Google Business Profile (GMB) and local-SEO data in plain language. After you sign in with your RightChoice account, the app gives ChatGPT read-only access to a private database containing only the locations your account can see: daily performance (calls, website clicks, direction requests, impressions), keyword rankings, location content and update history, and market research data. ChatGPT first looks up RightChoice's metric definitions and business rules in the product knowledge base, then runs read-only SQL queries against your data to answer questions such as which locations gained or lost calls this month, how keyword rankings moved, or which profiles need attention. Small results are returned in full; larger results come back as a statistical summary with sample rows and a time-limited download link to the complete CSV. The app never modifies your data, your Google Business Profiles, or your RightChoice account.
